items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: And they were more like relations to other show people, show folk, you know, like -- men and women, like Harry Richman, the great jazz singer, and that lady -- what's her name? Belle Baker.

ctx.x: Well, they performed here in New York City and on the Keith Circuit, like that, you see, but what it was, Buck and Bubbles was actually stars, you see. They was box office, you see. They'd draw crowds, you see. What they called SRO, Standing Room Only, you know. They'd see Buck and Bubbles name, and that's what happened, people would flock to the theater, you see. They'd read about them, or anything like that. And they were favorites of people like Jack Dempsey, the Rothschilds, Chrysler, important people, like…
Let's get back now to your first performance with Buck and Bubbles, and what was that like?
